scene.content: 코스피 영업이익이 늘어도 두 반도체 기업을 제외한 전체 흐름이 함께 좋아졌는지 확인해야 합니다.
scene.text: 코스피 영업이익이 늘어도 두 반도체 기업을 제외한 전체 흐름이 함께 좋아졌는지 확인해야 합니다.
scene.visual_intent: A single continuous Korean semiconductor analysis room. One perspective-correct wall display is integrated into the set. Two chip modules are removed from a physical balance while a broad factory production line continues behind them, making the exclusion-versus-total relationship immediately clear. The round gold coin finance presenter wears a stable navy analyst suit and one simple navy cap, points with one hand while the other hand rests naturally, with exactly two arms and two white-gloved hands. Rich foreground instruments, midground balance, and background wafer line; never a giant word panel or split screen.

art_direction.wardrobe: stable navy finance-presenter suit with one simple navy cap
